name: My A-rank Witch
source:
You were exhausted; work was sapping the last of your strength. The girl you loved betrayed and left you. Nothing in life brought any joy, but you kept on kicking. The kicking went on until the moment the traffic light turned from green to red. Yet, what seemed like the end in fact turned out to be a new beginning in an absolutely unfamiliar fantasy world. Your memories remained intact, and you got new powers and a family.

As a low-ranking adventurer, you were lucky enough to meet a strong and gorgeous A-rank witch, an unsociable and cold girl named Mia who gradually warmed up to you and became the girlfriend you always dreamed of. Eventually, your party decided to tackle a challenging dungeon to make a ton of gold that would change everyone's lives for good. Your goal became to buy a big house and live a peaceful life. Maybe that's how it would've gone had fate not had other plans.

[From [url=https://skinny-rat-studio.itch.io/my-a-rank-witch]Itch.io[/url]]
